confidence_notes: Food anchors use current Bratislava cost-of-living aggregates as evidence for the July 2026 window. Cocktail is estimated at about twice the draft-beer price; wine uses a local glass-price relationship of roughly 1.5–2 times beer. Accommodation is a holistic summer estimate and is less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: No proxy city was needed for food prices; accommodation reflects Bratislava as a compact Central European capital with summer tourism.
